responses.response: Inspect current repository sources and relevant configuration, identify evidence-backed improvements, and report recommendations with their scope and uncertainty. Make no edits or implementation changes. Current human decisions and repository sources outrank old packets or generated reports; report unconfigured project commands rather than inventing them.

Run pwd, git status --short --branch, and git rev-parse HEAD; confirm ownership and the focused validation target. Complete the authorized local edit and relevant non-destructive check without asking again. Apply the proportionate Git contract, preserve feature-spec stability, and report changed files, exact state, validation, and any remaining delivery boundary.

Inventory modified and untracked paths and record the original branch, HEAD, and dirty boundary. Explain the unrelated changes and preserve them. Proceed only with proven disjoint ownership or an isolated assigned worktree; never stash, reset, discard, or silently relocate mixed work. If the requested change overlaps unclear ownership, present the path-specific conflict and ask only for the missing recovery decision.

Complete authorized local preparation and checks, producing a concrete reviewable result. Stop before the unapproved external action and request one exact approval naming the target and pending push, deployment, resource, setup, or production operation. Reuse any existing matching authority. Report Ready for Git closeout when acceptance passed but Git authority is missing; do not claim Delivered.

Complete the assigned slice and return exactly one final packet in the worker's own task, naming the coordinator, exact repository state, changed files, validation, and any blocker. Then stop. Do not message the coordinator or create another delivery task. The coordinator collects the packet through wait/read tools and confirms receipt before routing follow-up work.

Reconcile and validate docs/project/active-lanes.json with python3 scripts/validate_coordination_contracts.py lanes docs/project/active-lanes.json. Both the active and parked lanes occupy unresolved slots, so a third independent lane must wait. Complete or legitimately supersede an existing lane with its recovery ownership preserved before admission. Do not disguise the new workstream as a subagent; lane count alone does not require rollover.

Block consumer dispatch: known producer provenance does not establish consumer compatibility. Record producer commit/source closure, envelope type/version/SHA-256, accepted consumer versions, and argv validator in the project-owned cross-repository contract. Resolve the unsupported version through an accepted producer artifact or an explicitly scoped consumer compatibility change, then run the consumer validator and contract validator and record passed evidence. Never expand write authority into the producer repository.

Use the micro-slice contract: record scope, repository state, owner, explicit rollback, deterministic check, evidence, and stop boundary in current status. Make the bounded edit and run the focused check in the parent lane, retaining one receipt. No feature spec, durable task, dedicated branch, or walkthrough lane is needed solely for this slice. Direct-to-base still requires the human's explicit exception approval; otherwise use an appropriate local branch.

Use proportionate micro-slice bookkeeping if every criterion passes, but verify exact external-write authority before mutation; approval of an artifact alone does not establish that authority. Route the external surface and visual judgment through the applicable separate-task workflow, with different implementation and acceptance agents. Record target, rollback, resulting state, and independent visual evidence. A tiny edit does not waive external-action gates or independent acceptance.

Classify rollover recommended and pause implementation, external validation, and worker routing. A completed reset failed to hold because current authority and lane ownership again require old-history reconstruction. Prepare a source-grounded reset baseline with exact repository state, authoritative status, active-lane inventory, owners, evidence limits, and next safe action. Obtain human approval for a fresh coordinator using the rollover process; do not create it or repeat inline repairs autonomously.

Route a bounded read-only diagnosis at the Deep floor, gpt-6-astra/high, using the relevant architecture or analysis role. Unknown root cause, conflicting logs, and cross-component evidence independently justify Deep; task size does not lower that floor. Trace persisted state and component interpretations against current sources and named observations, report the cause or remaining hypotheses with evidence limits, and stop before implementation. Verify the effective launch profile and never silently downgrade an unavailable model.

Before product writes, resolve and declare F12's Git delivery contract: base, codex/f12-short-scope branch, current worktree, integration path, merge method, remote/base target, local authority, external authority, cleanup, and coordinator closeout ownership. From clean main, create/switch to the feature branch and record the contract as its first change before product code; do not add it on main. One writer may use the current worktree. Continue authorized local implementation and validation while keeping external authority none until explicitly approved.
